The sentence ending "The opposition then appealed to the Supreme Court of Justice and the Senate voted to suspend the government, which was referred to the Constitutional Court of Justice" implies a concluding clause about the judicial ruling's outcome or the court's decision to investigate the suspension.

Final token "Justice" ends an incomplete noun phrase ("to the Tribunal of Justice"), part of a clause describing a judicial appeal ("The matter was referred to the Tribunal of Justice of the Supreme Court"), expecting "of Brazil" or "which ruled the suspension was invalid" or similar.
